description: Use when you need to compare two lists of lines. Marks each distinct line only_a, only_b or both, matched exactly as sent, as a CSV. $0.01 USDC on Base per answer via x402; a refusal is free.

text.description: Two lists of lines: a line ---A---, then list A, then a line ---B---, then list B, one item per line. At most 1,048,576 bytes of UTF-8 and 50,000 lines; a line break at the very end is not a line.

name: diff-two-line-lists
title: Diff two line lists
